title: Address
description: A numeric address. Requires: Street address, including numerics. Allows: Common name, venue.

fields.title: Street Name
fields.description: The name of the street the numeric address is on.

title: Mile-Marker / Landmark
description: A mile-marker or landmark on a road. Requires: Mile marker/landmark, road name. Allows: Venue.

fields.title: Road Name
fields.description: The road the call is on. Use 'US-' for US routes and 'I-' for interstates. Add direction of travel.

fields.title: Mile-Marker / Landmark
fields.description: The mile-marker or landmark. Add 'MM' before a mile-marker.

title: Latitude & Longitude
description: A latitude and longitude. Requires: Two float values. Allows: Additional information, venue.

fields.title: Latitude
fields.description: The latitude, in *DECIMAL DEGREES*, of the incident.

fields.title: Longitude
fields.description: The longitude, in *DECIMAL DEGREES*, of the incident.

fields.title: Additional Information
fields.description: OPTIONAL: More information on what is at this location.
fields.placeholder: Ex: Parking Lot of Blacksburg Transit

title: Intersection
description: An intersection of two roads. Requires: Two or more roads. Allows: Multiple roads.

fields.title: Intersection: Road #1
fields.description: The first road of the intersection.

fields.title: Intersection: Road #2
fields.description: The second road of the intersection.

fields.title: Intersection: Road #3
fields.description: The third road of the intersection.

title: Custom Location
description: Custom text to describe the location if none of the above fit.

fields.title: Custom Text
fields.description: Enter the custom location that doesn't fit other formats.
